name: dev.agentsupply/agentsupply
title: AgentSupply
description: Verification & real-world services for AI agents: EU VAT, LEI and email checks, human tasks.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List all services with status (live = callable now, pilot = request-only), indicative pricing and how to use them.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Get full details for one service: inputs, outputs, fulfilment, turnaround and indicative pricing.

tools.name: submit_request
tools.description: Request any service (pilot services, volume access to live tools, or 'custom' for anything not listed). Describe the problem, volume, frequency and what you would pay. A human reviews every request. Returns request_id, status_token and status_url. Nothing is charged.

service_id.description: Catalog service id, or 'custom' for anything not listed.

problem.description: What you need and why. Include the task your agent could not complete.

requirements.description: Concrete requirements: coverage, accuracy, format, constraints.

example_input.description: Example of what you would send us.

expected_output.description: Example or schema of what you expect back.

monthly_volume.description: Expected number of units/requests per month.

max_price_per_unit.description: Maximum price you would pay per unit/request.

one_off_budget.description: Total budget for a one-off job.

interface_pref.description: How you want to integrate/receive results.

principal_type.description: operator = the agent acts for a person or organisation; independent = autonomous agent without a human principal.

agent_card_url.description: URL of your A2A Agent Card, if any (https).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended – otherwise poll the status URL).

callback_url.description: Optional https URL for future status notifications (not yet active in the pilot).

tools.name: respond_to_request
tools.description: Send a message on a previously submitted request: accept our quote (accept_quote=true), answer our questions or add details.

accept_quote.description: True to accept the quote in our latest message.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Check the status of a previously submitted request and read our reply (quote, result or decline).

tools.name: check_eu_vat
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT identification number against the European Commission's VIES service. Returns validity and, where disclosed by the member state, registered name and address. Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

country_code.description: EU member state code, e.g. DE, FR, EL (Greece), XI (Northern Ireland). Optional if vat_number has a prefix.

vat_number.description: VAT number, with or without country prefix, e.g. DE123456789.

tools.name: lookup_lei
tools.description: Look up a legal entity in the global GLEIF LEI index by 20-character LEI or by company name. Returns legal name, status, jurisdiction and registered address (up to 5 matches for name search). Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

name.description: Company name to search for (used when lei is not given).

tools.name: check_email_domain
tools.description: DNS-based check of an email address's domain: MX records, SPF, DMARC policy and a disposable-provider heuristic. Does not send email or probe mailboxes. Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

email.description: Email address to check (only the domain is used).

tools.name: check_phone_number
tools.description: Validate and normalise a phone number: valid or not, country, type (mobile, fixed line, toll-free …), E.164 and international format. Offline; the number is not called. Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

phone_number.description: Phone number, ideally with country code (+49 …).

default_country.description: ISO country code used when the number has no country code, e.g. DE.

tools.name: request_company_verification
tools.description: Request a structured verification report for a company in the EU/UK (registry status, address, officers where public, VAT/LEI cross-checks, red flags). Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Indicative: Hypothesis: EUR 1–5 per automated report; EUR 15–40 human-reviewed.

company_name.description: Legal or trading name of the company.

country.description: Country of the company (ISO code or name).

identifiers.description: Optional: register number, VAT ID, LEI.

focus.description: Optional: what matters most (e.g. still active? who are the directors?).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Indicative: Hypothesis: EUR 0.50–3 per check.

expected_price.description: Optional: the price you were offered.

context.description: Optional: what you intend to buy and why you are unsure.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
